a51381928954.Inclusiveness: Inclusiveness is about designing systems that empower and can be used by people with a broad range of needs and abilities, not about unequal outcomes for similar groups.
a51381928954.Transparency: Transparency concerns whether people can understand how the system makes decisions; the core issue here is the biased outcome itself.
a51381928954.Accountability: Accountability is about who answers for the system and keeps human control; it does not describe the disparity in outcomes between groups.

ab44912bb17c.Fairness: Fairness focuses on avoiding biased outcomes between groups, not on explaining how a specific decision was reached.
ab44912bb17c.Reliability and safety: Reliability and safety is about consistent, safe operation under expected and unexpected conditions, not about explaining decisions.
ab44912bb17c.Privacy and security: Privacy and security covers protecting personal data, not making the model's reasoning understandable.

a0b0cc3cd12b.Fairness: Fairness concerns avoiding biased treatment of groups in outcomes such as approvals or rankings, not designing for accessibility needs.
a0b0cc3cd12b.Accountability: Accountability is about human ownership and oversight of the system, not about who can use it.
a0b0cc3cd12b.Transparency: Transparency is about explaining how the system works, which does not make it usable by people with disabilities.

b1da6212e09e.Transparency: Transparency is about making the system's behavior understandable, not about who is answerable for it and keeps control.
b1da6212e09e.Inclusiveness: Inclusiveness is about designing for a broad range of users and abilities, not about governance and oversight.
b1da6212e09e.Reliability and safety: Reliability and safety is about the system behaving consistently and safely; the board and override authority are governance measures.

9a006e8f5aa4.Fairness: Fairness is about avoiding biased outcomes for groups; testing edge cases and failing safely is about dependable behavior.
9a006e8f5aa4.Privacy and security: Privacy and security covers protection of patient data, not how the model behaves when given unexpected inputs.
9a006e8f5aa4.Transparency: Transparency is about explaining decisions; deferring when unsure is a safety behavior, not an explanation.

aa574d57ea60.Accountability: Accountability is about who is answerable for the system, not about how personal data is collected and protected.
aa574d57ea60.Inclusiveness: Inclusiveness is about designing for people of all abilities and backgrounds, not about data protection.
aa574d57ea60.Fairness: Fairness is about equitable outcomes across groups; encryption and deletion requests are data protection measures.

6955a2527626.Accountability: Accountability is about human ownership and control of the system; labeling output informs users rather than assigning responsibility.
6955a2527626.Reliability and safety: Labeling output does not make the model behave more consistently or safely; it tells users what they are interacting with.
6955a2527626.Fairness: Fairness is about avoiding biased outcomes for groups, which disclosure of AI use does not address.

850824c2f252.Protected material detection for text: Protected material detection flags known copyrighted text such as lyrics or articles in model output; it does not detect injected instructions in documents.
850824c2f252.Groundedness detection on completions: Groundedness detection checks whether output is supported by source material, not whether a document contains malicious instructions.
850824c2f252.A custom blocklist on output text: A blocklist matches specific terms you list; it cannot reliably detect instructions hidden in arbitrary documents.

fb8ec1cc9bff.Hate and fairness, profanity, spam, and: Profanity is handled by optional blocklists and spam is not a harm category of the default classifiers.
fb8ec1cc9bff.Violence, misinformation, sexual, and fr: Misinformation and fraud are not among the four harm categories that the default filter classifies.
fb8ec1cc9bff.Sexual, violence, jailbreak, and protect: Jailbreak detection and protected material are separate optional filters, not two of the four harm categories.

ec62bf4fbe68.Set the violence threshold to block low,: This is the strictest setting and blocks low severity content, which is the behavior the writers are complaining about.
ec62bf4fbe68.Set the violence threshold to block medi: This setting still blocks medium severity content, which the studio wants to allow.
ec62bf4fbe68.Turn off all content filters for the dep: Turning filters off would allow high severity violence too, and disabling filters requires approval; it is far broader than needed.

bca78e5fa420.The model's response was cut off because: Truncation at the token limit returns a successful response with a finish reason of length, not an HTTP 400 content_filter error.
bca78e5fa420.The deployment has run out of tokens-per: Quota and rate limit problems return HTTP 429 errors, not a content_filter code.
bca78e5fa420.The completion was filtered after genera: A filtered completion returns a finish reason of content_filter in a normal response; an HTTP 400 with content_filter means the prompt itself was filtered.

382f5d1fd168.Prompt Shields for user prompt attacks: Prompt Shields detects jailbreak attempts in inputs, not copyrighted text in outputs.
382f5d1fd168.The self-harm harm category filter: The self-harm category detects content about hurting oneself, which is unrelated to reproducing lyrics.
382f5d1fd168.Groundedness detection for completions: Groundedness detection checks whether output is supported by provided sources; it does not identify known copyrighted text.

2d9880d4b8f5.A credential that authorizes an applicat: Authentication tokens exist, but in language models a token is the unit of text the model reads and generates.
2d9880d4b8f5.A numeric score showing how confident th: Confidence scores are not tokens; tokens are pieces of text such as words, subwords, or punctuation.
2d9880d4b8f5.A complete sentence that the model store: Tokens are usually smaller than words or sentences, and models do not store sentences as long-term memory.

a56e913567c8.A compressed copy of the original text u: Embeddings cannot be decompressed back into the original text; they encode meaning as vectors for comparison.
a56e913567c8.A set of rules that tells the model how: Formatting rules are given in prompts or system messages, not encoded as embeddings.
a56e913567c8.A label that classifies text into one of: A category label is the output of classification; an embedding is a dense vector describing meaning.

3ab5aff00e88.Tokenization: Tokenization splits text into tokens before processing; it does not compute relationships between tokens.
3ab5aff00e88.Backpropagation: Backpropagation is how weights are updated during training, not how token relationships are computed during processing.
3ab5aff00e88.Content filtering: Content filtering is a safety layer around a deployment and is not part of the transformer architecture.

39cd7c4e64a1.It looks up a matching answer stored in: Generative models do not retrieve stored answers; they generate output one token at a time.
39cd7c4e64a1.It translates the prompt into a search q: A plain language model does not search the web; it generates text from patterns learned in training.
39cd7c4e64a1.It selects one answer from a fixed list: Selecting from fixed replies describes a rules-based bot, not a generative model.

23c0c7019b48.Word count difference: Counting words ignores meaning and does not compare embedding vectors.
23c0c7019b48.Token-per-minute rate: Tokens per minute is a throughput and quota measure, not a similarity score.
23c0c7019b48.Model temperature: Temperature controls randomness in generation and has nothing to do with comparing vectors.

fbe3261a5610.An image generation model such as gpt-im: Image generation models create pictures from prompts; they do not produce text vectors for search.
fbe3261a5610.A speech to text model such as a transcr: Transcription models convert audio to text and do not create vectors for semantic search.
fbe3261a5610.A reasoning chat model with a high tempe: Chat models generate text responses; embedding models are the right choice for creating search vectors, and temperature is irrelevant here.

a752fca413ba.A high temperature, such as 1.5: High temperature increases randomness, which works against consistent, factual extraction.
a752fca413ba.The maximum temperature of 2: The maximum value produces the most random output, the opposite of what the app needs.
a752fca413ba.A temperature of 1 combined with a top_p: These are typical defaults that allow a fair amount of variation; lowering temperature makes output more focused and repeatable.

ffc8ab223239.Decrease the max tokens setting: Lowering max tokens only shortens responses; it does not add variety.
ffc8ab223239.Add a stop sequence after the first slog: A stop sequence ends generation early and does not make the content more varied.
ffc8ab223239.Set the temperature to 0: A temperature of 0 makes output as deterministic as possible, which would reduce variety further.

e06c6fe3b50c.The maximum number of tokens that can ap: The response length limit is set by max tokens, not top_p.
e06c6fe3b50c.The number of alternative responses the: The number of returned choices is set by a separate parameter such as n, not top_p.
e06c6fe3b50c.The penalty applied to tokens that alrea: Repetition is controlled by presence and frequency penalties, not top_p.

9536b57b98ce.Always set both to 0 so output is fully: Guidance recommends changing one of the two at a time, and even very low values do not guarantee identical output.
9536b57b98ce.Leave both at defaults and instead raise: Max tokens limits response length; it does not make the choice of tokens more predictable.
9536b57b98ce.Raise top_p and lower temperature so the: Moving them in opposite directions makes results hard to reason about; guidance is to change only one.

4c6f4734f749.Lower the temperature so the model write: Temperature affects randomness, not response length limits, so the truncation would continue.
4c6f4734f749.Add a stop sequence at the end of each p: Stop sequences end generation earlier, which would make truncation worse.
4c6f4734f749.Switch the deployment type from Standard: Deployment type affects data processing location and quota, not the maximum length of a single response.

aa59469c605c.The reasoning model requires a higher te: Temperature cannot exceed 2 for any model, and reasoning models do not accept the parameter at all.
aa59469c605c.Reasoning models only accept these setti: Sampling parameters cannot be set through a system message; reasoning models simply do not support them.
aa59469c605c.The deployment must be changed to Provis: Deployment type does not change which request parameters a model supports.

e22e6748d94f.Increase the temperature so the model us: Temperature does not change how many tokens the conversation history consumes.
e22e6748d94f.Switch to a Global Batch deployment for: Batch deployments are for asynchronous jobs and do not increase a model's context window.
e22e6748d94f.Increase the max output tokens setting f: Raising output tokens consumes more of the context window and makes the problem worse.

be0e32405a35.Global Standard: Global Standard can process data in any Azure region worldwide, which breaks the EU-only requirement.
be0e32405a35.Global Batch: Global Batch processes in any region and is for asynchronous jobs, not interactive EU-only inferencing.
be0e32405a35.Global Provisioned: Global Provisioned uses reserved capacity rather than pay-per-token billing, and it can process data in any region.

15da4c1b6083.Regional Provisioned: Provisioned deployments require reserving throughput units, which does not suit a startup that wants pay-per-token billing.
15da4c1b6083.Standard: Standard keeps processing in one Azure geography and has lower default quota than Global Standard.
15da4c1b6083.Developer: The Developer type is for evaluating fine-tuned models, with a limited lifetime and no SLA.

38d690eba726.A Global Standard deployment with defaul: Global Standard is pay-per-token and latency can vary at high sustained volume, which the call center cannot accept.
38d690eba726.A Global Batch deployment: Batch deployments process asynchronous jobs with a target turnaround of up to 24 hours, not real-time requests.
38d690eba726.A Data Zone Standard deployment with pay: Data Zone Standard is still pay-per-token without guaranteed capacity, so latency can vary under load.

e52d7d628857.Regional Provisioned: Reserving provisioned throughput for a one-time offline job is expensive and unnecessary when real-time latency isn't needed.
e52d7d628857.Standard: Standard handles real-time requests at standard pricing and has lower quota, so a two-million-item job would be slower and cost more.
e52d7d628857.Developer: The Developer type is meant for evaluating fine-tuned models, not large production jobs.

cbd29193ede5.Global Standard: Global Standard can process data in any Azure region, which doesn't meet the single-geography requirement.
cbd29193ede5.Data Zone Standard: Data Zone Standard processes data anywhere within a multi-country data zone, which is broader than one geography.
cbd29193ede5.Global Provisioned: Global Provisioned uses reserved capacity instead of pay-per-token billing and can process data in any region.

5b83042b3a8b.gpt-4.1-mini: The model parameter routes to a specific deployment, so it takes the deployment name, which differs from the model name here.
5b83042b3a8b.The project endpoint URL: The endpoint is used to create the client, not as the model parameter.
5b83042b3a8b.The Foundry resource name: The resource name is part of the endpoint and does not identify a specific deployment.

37e7bbf80dcf.A text embedding model such as text-embe: Embedding models create vectors from text and cannot answer questions about images.
37e7bbf80dcf.An image generation model such as gpt-im: Image generation models create images from prompts; they are not used to answer questions about an input photo.
37e7bbf80dcf.A speech to text model used for audio tr: Transcription models convert audio to text and cannot analyze photos.

d4869fd02fd7.The largest reasoning model available in: Reasoning models spend extra tokens thinking, which raises cost and latency for a simple classification task.
d4869fd02fd7.An image generation model with low quali: Image models generate images and cannot classify text messages.
d4869fd02fd7.An embedding model used to generate the: Embedding models produce vectors, not category names; a small chat model can classify directly.

568f556fe963.A small, low-latency chat model tuned fo: Small fast models trade depth for speed and are weaker at complex multistep reasoning.
568f556fe963.An embedding model with high vector dime: Embedding models create vectors for similarity search and do not solve problems.
568f556fe963.A text to speech model with a neural voi: Text to speech models convert text to audio and do not perform reasoning.

de7e6aa09131.Fine-tuning: Fine-tuning retrains a model on a dataset; adding examples to the prompt does not change the model's weights.
de7e6aa09131.Grounding with retrieval: Retrieval grounding adds relevant source data to a prompt, not example input and output pairs.
de7e6aa09131.Zero-shot prompting: Zero-shot prompting gives instructions without any examples, which is the opposite of this approach.

64481060f493.Fine-tune the model every month on the p: Monthly fine-tuning is costly and slow, and it is not needed to give the model current reference content.
64481060f493.Raise the temperature so the model gener: Temperature only affects randomness; it does not give the model access to current policies.
64481060f493.Increase max tokens so the model can rec: Max tokens limits response length and does not provide new knowledge to the model.

014c81a07447.Overfitting to the training data: Overfitting describes poor generalization during training, not fabricated statements at inference time.
014c81a07447.A content filter false positive: A false positive is a safe output being blocked; here the output was delivered but incorrect.
014c81a07447.Prompt injection by a malicious user: Prompt injection is an attack that changes model behavior; the model inventing facts can happen without any attack.

9aef79bd3971.A chatbot that writes a poem when a user: Writing a poem on request is a single generative response with no planning or tool actions.
9aef79bd3971.A model that translates a paragraph from: Translation is a single transformation of text, not a goal-directed sequence of actions with tools.
9aef79bd3971.A model that summarizes a long article i: Summarization is one generative task and doesn't involve tools or acting on behalf of the user.

7e0178e7bf16.Language detection: Language detection identifies which language the text is written in, not the main topics.
7e0178e7bf16.Sentiment analysis: Sentiment analysis measures positive or negative opinion, not the main concepts in the text.
7e0178e7bf16.Named entity linking: Entity linking connects named entities to a knowledge base entry, not general talking points like 'interest rates'.

b020698a1cd9.Key phrase extraction: Key phrase extraction returns main concepts but does not categorize them as people, organizations, or dates.
b020698a1cd9.Opinion mining: Opinion mining links sentiment to aspects of a product or service; it does not categorize entities.
b020698a1cd9.Language detection: Language detection only identifies the language of the text.

715ea411152e.Document-level sentiment analysis only: Document-level sentiment gives one overall label and would likely report 'mixed' without linking sentiment to staff or breakfast.
715ea411152e.Key phrase extraction: Key phrase extraction would list 'staff' and 'breakfast' but would not say how guests felt about each.
715ea411152e.Named entity recognition: Entity recognition finds categorized entities but does not attach opinions to them.

b3673046d62e.Abstractive summarization: Abstractive summarization generates new sentences that paraphrase the text, so summary sentences may not appear verbatim in the source.
b3673046d62e.Conversation summarization: Conversation summarization is designed for chat and call transcripts, not long contract documents.
b3673046d62e.Key phrase extraction: Key phrase extraction returns short phrases, not summary sentences.

ccfc95790eea.Speech synthesis: Speech synthesis does the opposite, converting text into spoken audio.
ccfc95790eea.Language detection: Language detection identifies the language of text; it does not convert audio into text.
ccfc95790eea.Optical character recognition: OCR reads printed or handwritten text from images; it does not transcribe audio.

2f4135bcb8c1.Speech recognition: Speech recognition converts spoken words into text, the opposite direction of what is needed.
2f4135bcb8c1.Optical character recognition: OCR reads text from images; it does not produce audio.
2f4135bcb8c1.Speech translation: Speech translation converts speech from one language to another; the app only needs to speak existing text.

865fc21465b5.Image classification: Image classification assigns a label to the whole image; it doesn't locate individual objects with boxes.
865fc21465b5.Optical character recognition: OCR extracts text from images and doesn't locate packages.
865fc21465b5.Image generation: Image generation creates new images rather than analyzing existing ones.

f25f25a2ead8.Object detection: Object detection returns rectangular bounding boxes, not pixel-level outlines.
f25f25a2ead8.Image classification: Image classification labels the whole image and doesn't locate the tumor at all.
f25f25a2ead8.Image tagging: Tagging returns descriptive labels for content in the image, not pixel-level masks.

471281e3e167.Image classification: Classification would label the image, for example as 'car', but would not read the characters on the plate.
471281e3e167.Semantic segmentation: Segmentation outlines regions of pixels and doesn't convert characters into text.
471281e3e167.Image captioning: Captioning generates a sentence describing the image, not the exact plate text.

c3903af7c1c2.Image classification: Classification labels existing images; it doesn't create new ones.
c3903af7c1c2.Object detection: Object detection finds objects in existing images and doesn't produce new images.
c3903af7c1c2.Image captioning: Captioning describes an existing image in text, the opposite direction from creating an image.

f377b7fc5c81.Named entity linking: Entity linking connects entities to knowledge base entries and is not designed to find and redact sensitive personal data.
f377b7fc5c81.Key phrase extraction: Key phrase extraction surfaces main topics and won't reliably identify or mask phone and ID numbers.
f377b7fc5c81.Language detection: Language detection only determines the text's language.

430b6560ac4a.Speech synthesis only: Synthesis alone turns text into audio but doesn't recognize the English speech or translate it.
430b6560ac4a.Language detection on the slides: Detecting the language of slide text doesn't translate spoken audio.
430b6560ac4a.Batch speech transcription: Batch transcription processes recorded files asynchronously and produces text in the same language, not live translation.

7e7ebf0aea59.Image generation from prompts: Image generation creates new images and doesn't pull data out of scanned documents.
7e7ebf0aea59.Speech recognition of audio: Speech recognition works on audio, not scanned PDFs.
7e7ebf0aea59.Sentiment analysis of text: Sentiment analysis measures opinion in text and doesn't extract structured invoice fields.

3e55820c68f3.Image classification of the video thumbn: Classifying one thumbnail can't describe each scene or produce a transcript.
3e55820c68f3.Text to speech with a neural voice: Text to speech generates audio from text and doesn't analyze video.
3e55820c68f3.Language detection on the video title: Detecting the title's language gives no information about individual scenes.

0c79bd684bcc.Custom text classification: Custom classification assigns whole documents to classes; it doesn't extract and label medical entities.
0c79bd684bcc.Language detection: Language detection only identifies the language of the notes.
0c79bd684bcc.Conversational language understanding: CLU predicts intents from short user utterances in conversational apps, not medical entities in notes.

57e212fd20f7.To configure the deployment's temperatur: Temperature and token limits are request parameters, not text in the system prompt.

583eebdcbf2d.assistant: Assistant messages hold the model's own previous replies, not questions from the user.
583eebdcbf2d.tool: Tool messages return results from tool or function calls, not user questions.

c49731fd7215.Deploy a second copy of the model with a: Changing deployment type doesn't let you test system messages, and it adds cost.
c49731fd7215.Write a batch job that sends prompts to: Batch jobs return results asynchronously, which is too slow for interactive prompt testing.

c98d26421884.The playground only supports models depl: The playground works with standard deployments, and deployment type doesn't affect knowledge of the catalog.
c98d26421884.The temperature is set too low for factu: A low temperature makes answers more focused; it can't give the model data it doesn't have.
c98d26421884.The content filter blocked the product n: A filtered prompt returns an error, not a generic answer.

7d674c2190ba.Chat completions with max tokens set to: Raising max tokens doesn't make chat completions store conversation state.

dbf7ac967efe.A model, a content filter, and a deploym: Content filters and deployment types apply to model deployments; they aren't the core components of an agent.

dbf7ac967efe.A dataset, a training job, and an endpoi: These describe training a custom model, not defining an agent.

cf92e26d6086.A workflow agent: Workflow agents orchestrate multiple agents and steps; a single no-code agent is a prompt agent.
cf92e26d6086.A fine-tuned agent: Fine-tuning changes a model's weights; it isn't an agent type in Foundry Agent Service.

f44cbec486c5.Code interpreter: Code interpreter runs Python for analysis and file processing; it isn't designed for retrieving passages from a document collection.
f44cbec486c5.Function calling: Function calling invokes your own code; it doesn't index or search uploaded handbooks by itself.
f44cbec486c5.Image generation: Image generation creates pictures and can't answer questions from handbook text.

d80ae47c8388.They are converted into fine-tuning data: File search doesn't retrain the model; it retrieves relevant chunks at query time.

d80ae47c8388.They are sent to a search engine on the: Uploaded files stay in a vector store for the agent and aren't published to the web.

981537aca21d.File search: File search retrieves relevant text passages; it doesn't run calculations or create charts.
981537aca21d.Web search: Web search retrieves current public information, not analysis of a private CSV.
981537aca21d.Azure AI Search: Azure AI Search grounds answers in an existing search index and doesn't compute statistics or draw charts.

4c4b3a6a2bd1.Code interpreter running in the agent sa: The sandbox is isolated and isn't meant to call the company's internal systems from its own app code.
4c4b3a6a2bd1.Web search to find the order on the inte: Order status is private data and isn't available through public web search.

7ad01e708beb.File search over last year's travel guid: Uploaded guides are static and won't contain today's disruptions.
7ad01e708beb.Code interpreter: Code interpreter runs Python in a sandbox and isn't a source of current news.
7ad01e708beb.A lower temperature setting on the model: Temperature affects randomness and can't give the model new information.

a21844736e50.File search with a new vector store: File search would require uploading and indexing the manuals again in a separate vector store.
a21844736e50.Code interpreter: Code interpreter runs code and doesn't query an existing search index.
a21844736e50.Image generation: Image generation creates pictures and can't retrieve manual content.

0fe3591bdf25.Increase the agent's max output tokens l: More output tokens produce longer answers but don't limit topics.
0fe3591bdf25.Add the code interpreter tool to the age: Code interpreter adds computation abilities and doesn't restrict what topics the agent covers.
0fe3591bdf25.Change the deployment type to Provisione: Deployment type affects throughput and billing, not the agent's behavior.

878bd3279d94.Call responses.create with model set to: The agent is referenced through the bound client and conversation; resending history isn't needed when a conversation holds it.
878bd3279d94.Create a new agent version on every user: Creating versions changes the agent definition and doesn't send user messages.
878bd3279d94.Upload each user message as a file to th: Vector stores hold knowledge files for file search, not conversation turns.

6b06344dc1bc.Instructions are ignored by agents after: Instructions guide the agent throughout the conversation, not just the first message.
6b06344dc1bc.Instructions can only be set in the syst: For an agent, instructions are stored in its definition, so the app doesn't send them with each message.
6b06344dc1bc.Repeating instructions would disable the: Repeating instructions is unnecessary, but it wouldn't disable any tools.

22baacaf1a3b.AzureKeyCredential with a hardcoded key: A hardcoded key goes against the keyless approach in the quickstart and is a security risk.
22baacaf1a3b.A shared access signature token: SAS tokens are used for storage access, not for authenticating to a Foundry project.

d1eabe59afee.A finish reason of length on each respon: A length finish reason means the output hit the token limit and says nothing about grounding.
d1eabe59afee.A higher token count than responses with: Token counts can vary for many reasons and don't prove that files were used.
d1eabe59afee.An HTTP 400 error code of content_filter: A content filter error means the prompt was blocked, not that the answer was grounded.

58d0c9881633.Few-shot examples of harmful responses: Adding harmful examples could encourage the behavior the team wants to avoid.
58d0c9881633.A larger max tokens value: Max tokens limits length and doesn't provide safety guidance.
58d0c9881633.A Global Batch deployment: Deployment type has no effect on what instructions the model follows.

3d7ad3df784a.A numeric star rating from one to five t: Sentiment analysis returns labels and confidence scores, not star ratings.
3d7ad3df784a.A list of the main concepts mentioned in: A list of main concepts is the output of key phrase extraction.
3d7ad3df784a.A rewritten version of the review that u: Sentiment analysis classifies opinion and doesn't rewrite text.

39ed3cd1914d.Prompt a chat model to remove anything t: A general prompt can work but gives less predictable results and no predefined categories, which is weaker for compliance.
39ed3cd1914d.Use key phrase extraction and delete the: Key phrases are topics, not sensitive data, so this would miss PII and remove useful content.
39ed3cd1914d.Use language detection and drop non-Engl: Language detection doesn't find personal information in any language.

0cce8faa132a.Named entity recognition: NER returns categorized entities such as people and places, not a language code for the document.
0cce8faa132a.Sentiment analysis: Sentiment analysis returns labels like positive or negative, not language codes.
0cce8faa132a.Key phrase extraction: Key phrase extraction returns phrases from the text, not a language identifier.

570d54fb23f3.A vision-enabled model with the audio se: image_url parts carry images; audio must be sent to an audio-capable model as input_audio.
570d54fb23f3.An embedding model that converts the aud: Embedding models don't accept audio prompts or answer questions.
570d54fb23f3.Any chat model, with the audio file name: A file name in text doesn't give the model the audio content, and not every model accepts audio.

d468c5e5402e.Set the response format to json_object: JSON mode controls text structure and doesn't produce audio output.
d468c5e5402e.Set temperature to 0 and max tokens to t: These settings affect randomness and length, not whether audio is returned.
d468c5e5402e.Send the prompt as an image_url content: image_url is for images; audio output is requested with the modalities and audio settings.

a750028bb8b7.Batch transcription followed by a chat m: Batch transcription is asynchronous and can take hours, far too slow for live conversation.
a750028bb8b7.Audio-enabled chat completions with one: Audio chat completions works for request and response, but the Realtime API is optimized for low-latency, live voice interaction.
a750028bb8b7.Content Understanding with the prebuilt-: Content Understanding analyzes recorded audio for extraction; it isn't a live conversational voice interface.

255c78a126bb.Real-time speech to text from the microp: Real-time transcription is designed for live streaming audio and is inefficient for tens of thousands of stored files.
255c78a126bb.Text to speech with a neural voice: Text to speech generates audio from text and doesn't create transcripts.
255c78a126bb.Speech translation: Speech translation converts speech to another language; the firm only needs transcripts.

3eda054b1ce6.Batch transcription: Batch jobs run on a best-effort basis and can take much longer to start and finish, which is too slow here.
3eda054b1ce6.Custom voice: Custom voice creates a branded synthetic voice for text to speech and doesn't transcribe audio.
3eda054b1ce6.Pronunciation assessment: Pronunciation assessment scores how words are spoken and isn't used for general transcription.

76fc89849ab4.A different neural voice for text to spe: Voices affect synthesized audio output, not recognition of spoken drug names.
76fc89849ab4.SSML prosody settings on the transcripts: SSML controls how text is spoken during synthesis, not speech recognition.
76fc89849ab4.Speech translation into a second languag: Translation would carry over the recognition errors and doesn't fix them.

14abf3d23ac1.The speech recognition language, such as: The recognition language applies to speech to text, not the voice used for synthesis.
14abf3d23ac1.The model deployment name of a chat mode: Chat deployments aren't voices; Azure Speech voices are chosen by voice name.
14abf3d23ac1.The audio input device for the microphon: The input device is used for recognition, not for choosing a synthesis voice.

3e3e3aaeb67d.voice: The voice element sits inside the root element and selects a voice; it isn't the root.
3e3e3aaeb67d.prosody: prosody adjusts pitch, rate, and volume inside a voice element; it isn't the root.
3e3e3aaeb67d.audio: The audio element inserts recorded audio; the document's root is a different element.

f481c9de89fe.<prosody rate=\"1000ms\"/>: prosody rate changes speaking speed and doesn't accept a duration to insert a pause.
f481c9de89fe.<say-as interpret-as=\"pause\"/>: say-as tells the engine how to interpret text such as dates or numbers; it doesn't insert pauses.
f481c9de89fe.<emphasis level=\"1000ms\"/>: emphasis sets stress on words and doesn't create a pause.

340aa1c30230.phoneme: phoneme specifies exact pronunciation using a phonetic alphabet, not overall speed and pitch.
340aa1c30230.break: break inserts pauses but doesn't change the speed or pitch of the speech.
340aa1c30230.say-as: say-as controls how content types such as dates are read, not speed or pitch.

6ad5820a7c9d.prosody with rate set to slow: Slowing the speech doesn't change how the characters are interpreted.
6ad5820a7c9d.voice with a different neural voice name: Changing the voice doesn't tell the engine to read the text as a date.
6ad5820a7c9d.break with strength set to strong: A pause doesn't change how the date characters are read.

ba4404fbbc80.emphasis with level set to strong: emphasis adds stress to specific words but doesn't apply an emotional speaking style.
ba4404fbbc80.prosody with volume set to loud: Louder speech isn't the same as an empathetic speaking style.
ba4404fbbc80.lang with xml:lang set to en-US: The lang element switches language for multilingual voices; it doesn't set emotional style.

c32226e993af.Custom speech: Custom speech improves speech recognition accuracy; it doesn't create a synthesized voice.
c32226e993af.Pronunciation assessment: Pronunciation assessment evaluates how a speaker pronounces words, not creating new voices.
c32226e993af.Speech translation: Speech translation converts speech between languages and doesn't create branded voices.

d64bc4528ae1.As a file uploaded to the deployment's v: Vector stores support file search for agents; images in prompts are sent as content parts.
d64bc4528ae1.As a base64 string pasted into the syste: Raw base64 in the system message text isn't treated as an image; it must be an image_url content part.
d64bc4528ae1.As an input_audio content part with the: input_audio is for audio input, not images.

e6d48ee65f66.Increase max tokens so the model can dow: Max tokens doesn't affect whether the service can reach the image URL.
e6d48ee65f66.Set the image detail parameter to high: detail controls resolution and token use, not network access to the image.
e6d48ee65f66.Switch from a Standard to a Provisioned: Deployment type doesn't let the service reach firewall-restricted URLs.

57777c668938.Set the image detail parameter to high: High detail processes more image tiles, which increases token use and latency.
57777c668938.Increase temperature to 1.5: Temperature affects randomness of text output, not how much of the image is processed.
57777c668938.Send each photo twice in the same messag: Duplicating images doubles image token cost with no benefit.

71bce5366609.Send each image in a separate deployment: Separate deployments don't share context, so the model couldn't compare the images directly.
71bce5366609.Combine the images into an embedding and: Chat models don't take raw embedding vectors as image input.
71bce5366609.Put one image in the system message and: Images are sent in user message content parts, and tool messages are for tool results.

38fb1c535784.As a URL that expires after 24 hours: Returning a URL was DALL-E behavior; gpt-image-1 models return base64 data.
38fb1c535784.As a file saved to the project's blob st: The image is returned in the API response, not saved to storage automatically.
38fb1c535784.As an SVG text string in the output_text: gpt-image-1 returns raster image data such as PNG or JPEG, not SVG text.

34c68c02d826.1536x1024: 1536x1024 is landscape, wider than it is tall.
34c68c02d826.512x512: 512x512 isn't one of the gpt-image-1 size options.

d3fd37c095e4.Set background to transparent with JPEG: JPEG doesn't support transparency, so transparent backgrounds need PNG.
d3fd37c095e4.Set quality to low with JPEG output form: Quality affects detail and speed; neither setting produces a transparent background.
d3fd37c095e4.Set output compression to 100 with PNG f: Output compression applies to JPEG and doesn't create transparency.

33a1ef65e358.Call the generations API with a prompt d: Generating from scratch creates a new image and won't preserve the rest of the original photo.
33a1ef65e358.Send the photo to a vision chat model an: Vision chat models return text about images, not edited images.
33a1ef65e358.Call the generations API with the detail: detail is a vision input setting for chat models; it doesn't edit images.

657496149e87.Set quality to high: High quality produces the most detail but is the slowest option, which is the opposite of what the app needs.
657496149e87.Set n to 10 for every request: Requesting more images per call increases processing work and doesn't make each image faster.
657496149e87.Set background to transparent: Background transparency affects the output appearance, not generation speed.

5c3c23fab925.Send the receipt to gpt-image-1 with a p: gpt-image-1 generates images and doesn't return extracted text values.
5c3c23fab925.Convert the receipt to an embedding and: Embeddings capture meaning for similarity search and don't extract specific values.
5c3c23fab925.Send the receipt to batch transcription: Batch transcription processes audio, not images.

31dfdd9ae3c8.A trained neural network that you must l: Analyzers are configured with settings and field descriptions; they don't require you to train a model with labeled data.
31dfdd9ae3c8.A dashboard that charts usage and cost f: Usage dashboards are monitoring tools, not the component that processes content.
31dfdd9ae3c8.A storage container that holds uploaded: Analyzers process content; storage is handled separately.

13ab74dce025.Documents and images only: Content Understanding also processes audio and video, such as call recordings and media files.
13ab74dce025.Audio and video only: Content Understanding also processes documents and images.
13ab74dce025.Text documents and live microphone strea: It handles images and video too, and it analyzes files rather than acting as a live microphone service.

a367d88028dc.prebuilt-documentSearch: prebuilt-documentSearch is a ready-to-use RAG analyzer; custom analyzers derive from the base analyzers.
a367d88028dc.prebuilt-read: prebuilt-read is a content extraction analyzer for OCR, not one of the base analyzers that custom analyzers inherit from.
a367d88028dc.prebuilt-image: prebuilt-image is the base for image analyzers; a scanned document form should use the document base.

2fb3276d3359.The prebuilt-videoSearch analyzer: prebuilt-videoSearch analyzes video segments and transcripts, not invoice documents.
2fb3276d3359.A custom analyzer based on prebuilt-audi: Audio analyzers process recordings, not invoice documents.
2fb3276d3359.The prebuilt-imageSearch analyzer: prebuilt-imageSearch produces general image descriptions for search, not invoice fields.

82b08fcc88d3.prebuilt-read: prebuilt-read performs basic OCR without layout, figure descriptions, or summaries.
82b08fcc88d3.prebuilt-layout: prebuilt-layout extracts structure such as tables and sections but doesn't add summaries or RAG-ready chunking.
82b08fcc88d3.prebuilt-callCenter: prebuilt-callCenter analyzes call recordings, not PDF documents.

9d8000f77961.prebuilt-invoice: prebuilt-invoice extracts fields from invoice documents, not call recordings.
9d8000f77961.prebuilt-layout: prebuilt-layout extracts document structure and doesn't process audio.
9d8000f77961.prebuilt-imageSearch: prebuilt-imageSearch describes images and doesn't analyze calls.

638d09e4e4a0.generate: generate lets the model produce values freely, such as summaries, so the value might not match the document text exactly.
638d09e4e4a0.classify: classify picks a value from a predefined set of categories, which doesn't fit a free-form invoice number.
638d09e4e4a0.segment: segment isn't a field method; segmentation is configured separately with enableSegment.

07294fd42cad.extract: extract pulls values as they literally appear and is supported for documents only, not for describing video scenes.
07294fd42cad.classify: classify chooses from fixed categories and can't write free-form scene descriptions.
07294fd42cad.enableOcr: enableOcr is a configuration setting for reading text, not a field method.

fb122ec844e3.Use the extract method on the call trans: extract copies literal values and is document-only; it can't assign one of three categories to a call.
fb122ec844e3.Use the generate method with no list of: generate without defined values could return inconsistent labels, unlike a fixed set of categories.
fb122ec844e3.Enable OCR on the audio file: OCR reads text from images and documents and doesn't apply to audio classification.

6ad81d669042.enableSegment set to true: enableSegment splits content into segments by category; it doesn't return confidence or source locations for fields.
6ad81d669042.enableOcr set to false: Turning off OCR would reduce extraction from scanned pages and doesn't add confidence scores.
6ad81d669042.contentCategories with an 'other' catego: Content categories control classification and routing, not field confidence and grounding.

3350eae15131.extract fields must use the type boolean: extract works with types such as string, date, and number; boolean isn't required.
3350eae15131.extract fields must be inside a contentC: Content categories are for segmentation and routing, not a requirement for extract fields.
3350eae15131.extract fields require the analyzer to b: extract is supported for documents, so a document base analyzer is appropriate.

ba9753df8e05.As a single string field that holds all: A single string loses the structure of each line item and makes the values hard to use.
ba9753df8e05.As three separate top-level number field: Separate top-level fields can hold only one value each, not a repeating list of line items.
ba9753df8e05.As a boolean field that indicates line i: A boolean only says whether items exist and doesn't capture their details.

724fb1f9933b.The description sets the maximum length: Descriptions guide extraction; they don't set length limits.
724fb1f9933b.The description is required only for dis: Descriptions affect extraction accuracy, not just display.
724fb1f9933b.The description chooses which base analy: The base analyzer is set with baseAnalyzerId, not field descriptions.

d4406ddce66a.Set enableSegment to false and add a sum: With segmentation off, the whole video is treated as one segment, so stories won't be split.
d4406ddce66a.Set enableOcr to true and enableLayout t: OCR and layout settings control text and structure extraction, not splitting video into stories.
d4406ddce66a.Use prebuilt-invoice as the base analyze: prebuilt-invoice is a document analyzer and isn't a valid base for video analysis.

b72e07f97c72.An image analyzer, because the input fil: Image analyzers aren't optimized for text-driven extraction; a document field schema is recommended for text-heavy goals.
b72e07f97c72.A video analyzer, because it samples fra: Video analyzers are for video content, and frames are downscaled, which hurts small text.
b72e07f97c72.An audio analyzer, because it includes s: Audio analyzers transcribe speech and can't read text from images.
